description: Payroll and supplier payouts to many wallets in one batch, on Solana and on the nine EVM chains (those with loteSplit true in GET /v1/chains). EVM: up to 50 wallets, in a verified USD stablecoin (USDC, USDT, PYUSD, USDG, USD1) — the batch is ONE transaction through the Vurto IBBs split contract, and the payer pays the exact amounts PLUS a 0.1% Vurto fee on the total. Solana: up to 20 wallets, in any token the payer holds (no swap, no fee), packed into one or a few transactions. The paying wallet and every receiving wallet are screened first (OFAC SDN list and, on Solana, the issuer freeze of six stablecoins); a blocked payer refuses with payer_blocked (403), and one blocked recipient refuses the whole batch with receiver_blocked (403) and details.index of that row, before anything is created. Each recipient becomes a regular invoice (history, on-chain verification). EVM returns { invoices[], evm: { split, invoiceIds[], base, fee, batchRef, deadline, steps[] } }: sign steps IN ORDER with prepare_signing (the approve step first, then the pay transaction step), send them, and call payout_report_payment with the PAY transaction hash and evm.invoiceIds. Solana returns { invoices[], transactions[] }: sign each transactions[i].transaction (prepare_signing, then POST to /v1/svm/execute) and call payout_report_payment with that signature and its invoiceIds. checks (Solana only, stablecoin token) adds a PAID analysis of every destination, turning the batch into two steps. With checks, Solana returns { invoices[], charge: { transaction, loteId, total, token, tokenDecimals, feeWallet, recipients }, reused[] } instead of transactions[]: sign charge.transaction (prepare_signing, POST to /v1/svm/execute), then call payout_charge with that loteId, the charge signature and payer to analyse every destination and get the approved transfers. Not re-charging a wallet already analysed (reused[]) needs the payer's signed session, which the API does not carry, so via MCP every destination is charged and reused[] is empty. On EVM, checks refuse with batch_paid_analysis_coming_soon. Errors: batch_not_available_on_chain (an EVM chain without the IBBs contract), stablecoin_required (an EVM batch, or a Solana checks batch, in a non-stablecoin token), batch_paid_analysis_coming_soon (checks on an EVM batch), batch_duplicate_recipient (add the amounts up in one row), batch_self_payment, too_many_recipients, token_not_listed, screening_unavailable (503, try again).

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checks.description: Optional, Solana only: the paid analysis tools to run on every destination (scorechain 0.15 USDC, merkle-science 0.60 USDC, per destination). Turns the batch into the two-step charge flow above.

payer.description: The wallet that signs and pays. EVM 0x address, or base58 on Solana.

amount.description: Human amount, e.g. "500" or "120.5". Exactly this reaches the wallet.

wallet.description: Receiving wallet (EVM 0x address, or base58 on Solana, case-sensitive). The payer cannot be one of them, and each wallet appears once (up to 50 on EVM, 20 on Solana).

token.description: Mint or symbol of a verified token, e.g. "USDC". Every recipient is paid in it. On EVM it must be a USD stablecoin; with checks on Solana it must be a USD stablecoin too.

name: payout_batch
